tool_count.note: Tool list sent to model not in evidence.

edit_primitive.note: Edits done via underlying runtime tools; definitions not in evidence.

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: SkillHone is just a bundle of skills following the [agentskills.io](https://agentskills.io) standard.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: diagnose a probe failure → decide whether the fix belongs in the prose, in a new helper script, in a reference page, or in any combination of those — and land it as a single atomic PR gated by a regression eval.
loop_primitives.note: Algorithm 1 iterates eval->propose->evaluate->decide; react from underlying agent runtime.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Each diagnosis corresponds to an Issue, each revision to a Pull Request, and each iteration's observations to a Wiki page.
planning_granularity.note: Issues act as persisted diagnoses/plans; closest value.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: At each development step, an agent runtime dynamically dispatches fresh, role-bounded optimization and evaluation subagents on demand.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: At each development step, an agent runtime dynamically dispatches fresh, role-bounded optimization and evaluation subagents on demand.

human_in_loop.note: skillhone-prd is interactive but gating code not in evidence.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: SkillHone represents each development step as a decision record

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: Wiki — per-iteration observations that later runs read.
long_term_memory.note: Persistent decision history in Forgejo issues/PRs/wiki; episodic_db closest for decision records.

state_persistence.evidence_quote: enabling cross-session refinement without rediscovering past rationale
state_persistence.note: Cross-session continuation of optimisation, not mid-run resume code.

self_verification.evidence_quote: land it as a single atomic PR gated by a regression eval
